text: “Welcome to Planet Ten! It’s your first day as an apprentice Block Manipulator.”. “I’m Mr. Martian. Head of training. Literally.”
“Glowblocks™ capture the POWER OF TEN! Ten smaller units join to make one bigger unit. Same value. Bigger wobble.”
“TEN-BOT will help you aim, split and collect. We will check the value and count the blocks together.”. “Only the next action is unlocked. Take your time!”
“Your job is to reshape deliveries so they fit the colony’s machines.”

I am TEN-BOT. Civic engineer. Your careful work will help our community. One ten rod is worth 10, but it is ONE separate block. Value counts the glowing cells. Block count counts separate pieces. Type the total value and the number of blocks. Then choose Check my answers.
Choose the pink Discombobulator below. It splits a bigger block into smaller blocks.
Now aim at the glowing ten rod and click it once. Keyboard: Tab to Ten block 1, then press Enter.
You split one ten into ten separate ones. Count the value, then count the separate blocks. Nothing was added or lost. Type the total value and the number of blocks. Then choose Check my answers.
Choose the blue Transmorgifier below. It joins ten matching blocks into one bigger block.
Hold the mouse or your finger on the first one, sweep across all TEN ones, then release. Keyboard: Tab to each one and press Enter. If some fall back, try again!

Ten ones joined into one ten. The ten glowing cells still have the same value. How many separate blocks can you pick up now? Type the total value and the number of blocks. Then choose Check my answers.
New delivery! ONE ten and TWO ones. Count the ten as 10 for value, but as just ONE separate block. Now add the two ones. Type the total value and the number of blocks. Then choose Check my answers.
Training complete! VALUE is how much the blocks are worth. BLOCK COUNT is how many separate pieces there are. Splitting and joining change the count, but keep the value.
For VALUE, each ten rod is worth 10 and each one is worth 1. Count the glowing cells, not just the separate pieces. Try again.
The value is right! For BLOCKS, count each whole rod once and each separate one once. Try the block count again.

Every machine needs particular arrangements of blocks. Each arrangement is a configuration. This machine needs TWO configurations, both with a value of 28. Precision first, apprentice. The community is counting on us.
Look at the WORD DESCRIPTION below the blocks: 2 tens and 8 ones. It names the blocks on the ground. It changes when you split or join them.
Look at VALUE on the green screen. Two tens are worth 20, and eight ones are worth 8. The total value is 28. Splitting and joining keep this value the same.
Look at BLOCKS beside VALUE. There are 10 separate pieces: two rods and eight ones. Count each whole rod as ONE block. Value 28, block count 10!
The first configuration asks for value 28 using exactly 19 blocks. We need a different arrangement of the same power. Split ONE ten rod into ten ones.

When the arrangement matches, press SUPPLY POWER below the green screen. The power transforming module takes the blocks and zaps the machine, unlocking one action. Each correct configuration earns a key.
Choose the pink Discombobulator, then click ONE ten rod. TEN-BOT will keep the other blocks safe. Watch the word description and block count change!
The word description now says 1 ten and 18 ones. Value: 28. Block count: 19. Configuration matched! Press SUPPLY POWER and watch the module zap the machine.
Power transformation in progress! Watch the blocks enter the module and the energy zap the machine. A correct configuration unlocks a machine action.

One key unlocked. The machine has grown legs. A promising development for planetary transport. It is 50 percent active. Configuration two needs value 28 using 10 blocks. Choose the blue Transmorgifier. Sweep across TEN ones and release to make one ten. Keyboard: Tab to each one and press Enter.
Now the word description says 2 tens and 8 ones. Value: 28. Block count: 10. The second configuration matches! Press SUPPLY POWER to unlock the final action.
Both configurations complete! Different arrangements, the same value of 28. Both keys are lit. Your wondrous machine is now 100 percent active!
The transport workers need reliable reflex testing. Configure this instrument with care, apprentice. The planetary economy depends on functioning knees.
Behold. The Hairy Legged Reflex Testing Machine. Fully active. You have protected the knees of our transport workers. Planet Ten can keep moving. An important contribution, apprentice.
Our repair crews need a specialist with excellent coordination. Prepare the microwave. Twenty hands will require a very thorough employee handbook.
Behold. The Alien Microwaving Microwave. Our newest repair specialist has twenty hands, and impeccable timing. You have strengthened the workforce. The community thanks you.
The bakery nursery needs a dependable breakfast system. Complete each configuration. Small appliances cannot build a strong economy on an empty crumb tray.
Behold. Mamma Toaster Feeds Her Babies. The next generation of breakfast appliances is nourished. You have secured the future of our bakeries. A serious achievement, apprentice.
Our dustbunny walking service needs equipment. Configure the collector carefully. Every small business begins with an idea. Some ideas shed.
Behold. The Dustbunny Dog Walker. A new neighbourhood walking service is ready for business. You have created employment, companionship, and a modest amount of lint. Excellent work.
The delivery district needs an accessible lift. Configure the power carefully. The building is unusually willing to cooperate.
Behold. The Grounded Elevator. The building now brings every floor to our delivery workers. You have improved access across the district. The architecture is taking this very seriously.
Mr. Martian needs coffee. This is a matter of planetary productivity. Complete the configurations with precision. I have marked this assignment essential.
Behold. A functioning coffee maker. Mr. Martian can now supervise the next shift. You have protected planetary productivity. I cannot overstate the importance of this beverage.
The community celebrations committee needs a morale specialist. Configure this device. Eight tentacles should provide adequate enthusiasm.

Behold. The Weirdly Flexible Alien Cheerleader Robot from the Planet Zargon. Our community festivals have their star performer. You have supported local celebrations and the businesses around them. Splendidly precise work.
The market growers need a way to use leftover fruit. Complete each configuration. Waste is unacceptable. Unusual anatomy is negotiable.
Behold. The Frankenfruit Blender. Leftover fruit has become our newest orchard assistant. You have reduced waste and supported the growers. The grapes appear ready for work.
This wrinkled seed will help our nursery. Water it with the required arrangements. Never judge a seed by its wrinkles. I have several respected colleagues with wrinkles.
Behold. The Cloudbun. From a gnarly flower comes a very gentle nursery companion. You have helped our growers welcome a new life. Small beginnings matter to Planet Ten.
This beautiful seed supports the compost gardens. Match each watering configuration. Beauty is not a guarantee of table manners.
Behold. The Slobber Slug. Its appetite for garden scraps will nourish our compost beds. You have supported next season’s harvest. The slime is a professional asset.
This crumpled seed belongs to the seed delivery programme. Supply its water precisely. Our smallest farms are counting on this delivery.
Behold. The Pocket Puffalo. A compact assistant for carrying seed packets between gardens. You have connected our growers. Economically significant, and remarkably pocket-sized.
This heart-marked seed is assigned to canal maintenance. Find the required arrangements. Our irrigation workers deserve dependable assistance.
Behold. The Jellyjaw. Its unusual mouth can clear weeds from irrigation channels. You have helped water reach our farms. A distinguished public service. Please admire it from here.
This knobbly seed will support the night gardens. Find different representations of the same value. Careful thinking keeps our growing community supplied.
Behold. The Moonkit. A watchful companion for the night-shift gardeners. Your different representations delivered the same value each time. You have helped protect the harvest. Meticulous work.
This bright seed belongs to the soil laboratory. Find distinct watering arrangements. Healthy soil is the foundation of our food supply. Even when the laboratory smells unusual.
Behold. The Mucus Mite. Its slime helps dry soil hold water. You have supported our growers through the next dry season. A small creature with a substantial civic responsibility.
This grooved seed will support the irrigation team. Find every required representation. The final delivery deserves the same care as the first.

Behold. The Tiny Star Otter. Our newest irrigation assistant will tend the garden streams. Your precise work has supported an entire growing community. Planet Ten is better supplied because of you, apprentice.
